VALENCIOUS 32KM WORLD & HIGH-FIDELITY RACES

Project Ashes • Godot 4.6 PBR & Jolt Physics Architecture • 8GB RAM PC Certified

Valencious 32,768m × 32,768m Continent Partitioning

Designed specifically for standard 8GB RAM PCs. The world is structured into 4,096 macro-sectors (512m × 512m each). Only the 3×3 sector grid surrounding the player is actively loaded into memory (~950 MB), while horizons (>350m) render as high-speed GPU Octahedral Impostor Billboards (50,000 trees & landmarks taking under 120 MB VRAM).

High mountains, river valleys, coastal ports, dense redwood forests, and corrupted Rift zones.

Northern Mountain Sects & Sky Monasteries

Perched atop misty cloud seas: pagodas, watchtowers, suspension bridges, and celestial leyline rifts.

20 Races of Valencious & Dual-Branch Evolution Matrix

Inspired by Tensura (Slime) and xianxia cultivation: bestowal of a true soul name consumes magicules and triggers metamorphosis, branching into either the Noble Humanoid Path (sleek aristocratic beauty, martial mastery, kingly aura) or the Beast Colossus Path (hulking primal titan, brute force, cataclysmic stomps).

Seamless Enterable Architecture & Portal Culling

Unlike traditional games that force a loading screen or black fade, every village dwelling, tavern, and watermill features a physical open doorway (1.3m × 2.4m). Characters walk straight inside without collision snags. To maintain smooth 60 FPS on 8GB RAM PCs, an intelligent occlusion manager dynamically toggles interior props based on distance.

1. Godot Compound Collision (-col)

Each building model (enterable_cottage.glb) exports dedicated sub-mesh colliders: Floor-col, Wall_Back-col, Wall_Front_Left-col, Wall_Front_Right-col, and Door_Lintel-col. The door opening itself has no collider, enabling fluid character movement.

2. Dynamic Prop Culling (18m Threshold)

EnterableBuildingManager.gd keeps small clutter (plates, tankards, chairs, hearth embers) hidden when the player is >18m away, saving 40-70 draw calls per house. The moment the player approaches within 18m, props fade in seamlessly.

3. Interior Camera Smoothing

Upon crossing the doorway portal, the third-person camera automatically adjusts its pitch and tightens ceiling collision detection to prevent the camera from clipping outside roof geometry.
